sources.title: Online Visa Application: Syria Tourist or Business alert
sources.publisher: Department of Immigration and Emigration, Sri Lanka
sources.jurisdiction: Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
sources.officialityEvidence: The live eta.gov.lk service is the Department of Immigration and Emigration's official Electronic Travel Authorization portal. Its current Alert 04 expressly identifies Syria and the sponsor-led head-office process.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Visitors from Syria who intend to apply for Tourist or Business visa may apply through Sri Lankan Sponsor

sources.title: General Information on Visa
sources.publisher: Department of Immigration and Emigration, Sri Lanka
sources.jurisdiction: Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
sources.officialityEvidence: The Department's live immigration.gov.lk visitor-visa page displays a 24 August 2026 update and links to the official ETA service.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Restricted nationals will not be able to apply tourist visa on arrival at the port of entry.

unresolved.reason: Sri Lanka's current portal names Syria only for a sponsor-led head-office Tourist or Business visa application with police-clearance, accommodation and other documents. The current Department page separately says all tourists can have ETA and bars unnamed restricted nationals from tourist visa on arrival; neither source identifies whether the Syria sponsor route issues an ETA or another advance visa, nor whether it is the unconditional ordinary-passport baseline. No current Syrian primary guidance resolving that conflict was recovered.
